skills.content:
---
name: reputation-guard-first-use-intake
description: >-
  Use this when setting up Reputation Guard for a new company — run §0 intake
  before config or scanning.
---
Use this on first open for a new company, before any Google/Yelp scan or draft reply.

Ask the Company Kit §0 intake questions (do not invent answers; do not reuse another company’s answers):

A. Company basics — public business name; file slug; timezone; local daily scan time; human owner who posts replies and gets the digest.
B. Locations — how many; for each: label, full address, public phone; whether digests always split by location (recommended yes if more than one).
C. Platforms — Google Business / Yelp / other; owner login available per listing; platforms to ignore for now.
D. Voice and risk — one-sentence brand voice; never-say list; Legal escalate owner; ops escalate owner.
E. SLAs and posting — ≤3★ reply SLA (common 48h); 4–5★ thank-you window (common 7 days); confirm bot drafts only / humans post; amplify/ads dark until trust gates.
F. Themes and industry — known top complaint themes or discover from first 2 weeks; optional industry pack; digest save path.
G. Go-live — baseline scrape now vs first scheduled morning; quiet if zero new (recommended yes).

After answers: write companies/<slug>/config.yaml and theme-library from blanks → human confirms → set first_use_complete → enable that company’s morning routine in their timezone.

Never start scanning until intake is confirmed.

skills.name: reputation-guard-company-kit
skills.description: Use this when running Reputation Guard after intake — blank Company Kit, severity ladder, risk checklist, digest shape.
skills.content:
---
name: reputation-guard-company-kit
description: >-
  Use this when running Reputation Guard after intake — blank Company Kit,
  severity ladder, risk checklist, digest shape.
---
Reputation Guard — Company Kit workflow (blank template; no company pre-filled).

After §0 intake, fill companies/<slug>/config.yaml with: company_id, company_name, timezone, scan_cron_local, platforms, locations[{id,label,address,phone}], notify.primary, digest_path, reply_rules (who_posts owners_only; sla_hours_low_star; shape thank → own_gap_once → invite_offline → stop; never-list; amplify dark_until_trust), brand_voice, escalate.legal, escalate.ops, industry_pack, first_use_complete.

Severity ladder for every company:
- Tone (rude, no greeting, jargon) → own welcome; invite private resolve; floor coaching
- Ops (wait, no status, dirty first look) → own the miss; contact + next step; ticket + SOP
- Money (price surprise, refund ask) → empathy; move price talk offline; manager review
- Legal-risk (data loss, injury, same-issue after pay, discrimination) → empathy only; no fault admit; private invite; Legal + owner same day

Draft risk checklist before any reply is shown to the owner:
- Correct location name and phone
- No admission of legal liability / data loss fault in-thread
- No arguing or “that didn’t happen”
- No staff naming / shaming
- No ask to delete or edit the review
- No fake ETA or guaranteed outcome
- No competitor cosplay or unscoped “best” claims
- No coupon / stars incentive
- One shopper-read line
- Offline owner assigned if ≤3★

Morning digest shape: new/changed per location; paraphrase no PII; severity + risk flags; DRAFT reply; ops fix pointer; shopper-read; quiet if zero new.

Clone recipe: run §0; write new companies/<slug>/; human confirms first_use_complete; enable that company’s morning routine; keep company data isolated.

Industry packs (optional overlays after intake only): general, repair, msp, medical_dental, hospitality — add suggested never-say + starter themes; never fill locations or phones.

routines.name: Reputation Guard morning scan
routines.description: Fires each local morning to scan Google/Yelp for new reviews and deliver a draft-only digest.
routines.content:
Run the Reputation Guard morning review scan for the configured company (companies/<slug>/config.yaml).

Locations come from that company’s config — never mix reply phones or location labels across stores. Use fill-ins until intake is complete: {{company_name}}, {{location_label}}, {{location_address}}, {{location_phone}}, {{digest_path}}, {{timezone}}.

Ground drafts in that company’s playbook/theme library if present; otherwise use Company Kit severity ladder + risk checklist. Do not invent star counts.

Scan Google + Yelp (and readable mirrors when platforms block) for new or changed reviews since last run, especially ≤3★ and notable 4–5★. Note blocked sources. Spin browser grunt for scrapes; never post replies.

Notify the human owner with a morning digest per location: new/changed count, star, paraphrase (no customer PII), severity + risk flags, DRAFT public reply (thank → own gap once → invite offline with the correct store phone → stop), in-store/ops fix pointer, and one shopper-read sentence. Never admit legal fault, argue, name staff, ask delete/edit, offer coupon-for-stars, or use unscoped “best” claims.

When material, also save the digest under {{digest_path}}. If no new reviews, stay quiet or send one line: no new reviews.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Chicago 0 5 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
